Micromanagement Master Chiang Kai-shek
Separate mouse/keyboard and controller settings. Stationary fire, farthest-first ordering and manual exclusions default off; other features default on. Confirm to apply and save.
Mouse / Keyboard
Controller
Defaults for this page
Select to attack

Selecting a ranged unit with a valid visible target opens attack targeting. Click another friendly unit to switch directly. Only a legal enemy target attacks; other clicks return to normal map selection. Right-click or controller Cancel still cancels.
Select to join

Without a reachable enemy, automatically enter join mode when an eligible friendly commander is on the same or adjacent tile. Click an eligible commander to join, or another friendly unit to switch directly.
Prevent right-click swaps
Right-click joins only when another friendly military unit shares the commander tile. Otherwise retain normal movement. Invalid joins on occupied tiles block move/swap.
Select to deploy

Selecting an individual packed unit opens deployment targeting. Click a legal unoccupied tile to deploy; click another friendly unit to switch, even on a legal deployment tile. Other invalid clicks return to normal map selection. Selecting the commander does not unpack the entire army.
Faster reinforcement: only commander
After clicking Reinforce, send directly only if you own exactly one commander and it is eligible. Owning multiple commanders always requires a choice.
Commander mobility reminder
Show a strong pink tile under friendly commanders with no packed units, reminding you of reduced mobility. Updates when the active input device changes.
Mod defaults
Restore defaults: stationary fire, farthest-first ordering and manual exclusions off; other applicable options on. Confirm to save, or Cancel to discard.
Reset Micromanagement Master Chiang Kai-shek
Micromanagement Master Chiang Kai-shek settings not saved
Could not write local mod settings. Your changes have not been saved. Check the settings data and retry; other mods’ data has been preserved.
Continuous deployment: retain commander
After deployment, retain commander selection while military units remain packed. Civilians and recon units do not count.
Continuous deployment: select next unit
After deployment, select and highlight the next packed military unit with movement and a legal deployment plot. Independent of commander retention.
Continuous attack selection

After a manual ranged attack, consider only ready units within 3 hexes of the attacker with a legal stationary target. Prioritize the same enemy, a shared commander, the same unit type, then the same class (ranged or siege), and finally nearest first. Selects only; never attacks automatically.
Focus Fire: highlight participants

Bright hex outlines mark available ranged units; pale gold fill marks participants. Hover an enemy to show eligible attackers and red arrows. When stationary fire is enabled, only units that can fire from their current tiles retain fill. Preview alone keeps native Focus Fire execution.
Focus Fire: manually exclude units

Off by default; requires participant highlighting. Click a friendly unit to remove or restore its pale gold fill. Its outline stays visible, and changing the hovered enemy does not undo manual exclusions.
Faster reinforcement: cycle commanders

Start with the closest commander eligible for reinforcement. Cycle with LB/RB, Up/Down, wheel or panel buttons. Cancel to return to your selected military unit. Ineligible commanders cannot be confirmed.

Focus Fire: keep units stationary
Focus Fire: farthest first
Off by default. Enable to fire only from current tiles and preserve formation. Disable to let native attack operations handle permitted movement. Independent of farthest-first ordering.
Off by default. Enable to fire from farthest to nearest, rechecking after each shot and stopping when the target disappears. Disable to avoid distance-based reordering.
Select to join: quick transfer

In automatic join mode, green tiles preview a land unit's transfer through an adjacent commander with Initiative. Hover to see the route and a cost of 1 movement. Click to join, then deploy once the engine confirms joining. Occupied tiles still select units. Deployment is rechecked after joining; if blocked, the unit stays packed.
Quick transfer stopped. If the unit has already joined, it remains in the commander; no further deployment was issued.

微操大师常凯申
鼠标／键盘和手柄分别配置。不移动单位、由远及近和手动排除默认关闭，其他功能默认开启。确认后生效并保存。
鼠标／键盘
手柄
本页默认设置
选中即进攻
选中单位时，有可攻击的可见敌人就自动进入攻击选格。点其他己方单位直接切换；只有合法敌方目标才执行攻击，其余点击返回普通地图选择。右键或手柄 B 仍可取消。
选中即加入
没有可攻击敌人，且同格或相邻一格有可加入的己方指挥官时，直接进入加入模式。点可加入的指挥官归队，点其他己方单位直接切换，不用先取消。
右键防换位
仅当指挥官所在格还有其他己方军事单位时，右键改为加入；该情况下无法加入则阻止换位。空格仍正常移动。
选中即部署
选中指挥官内已收纳的单个单位后，直接选择退出落点。点合法空格部署；点有其他己方单位的格子优先切换，即使该格可以部署。其余无效点击返回普通地图选择。选中指挥官本人不展开整军。
更快的增援：唯一指挥官直达
主动点击增援后，只有总共拥有一位指挥官且其可接收时才直接派遣。拥有多位时，即使仅一位合法，也必须选择。
指挥官移动力不足提醒
己方指挥官内没有实际收纳单位时，脚下显示加深的粉色底座，提醒留意机动力下降。切换输入设备时按对应组设置刷新。
本模组默认设置
恢复默认：集中开火的不移动单位、由远及近、手动排除关闭，其他适用设置开启。点击“确认变更”保存，取消则放弃。
恢复微操大师常凯申默认
微操大师常凯申设置未保存
本地 Mod 设置数据无法写入，本次修改尚未保存。请检查本地设置后重试；其他 Mod 的存储数据已保留。
连续部署：保持指挥官焦点
派出单位后，只要仍收纳军事单位，就保留指挥官选择；不计平民和侦察单位。
连续部署：选择下一个单位
部署后自动选中仍有移动力且存在合法退出格的军事单位，并高亮头像。与保持指挥官焦点分别开关。
连续进攻
手动远程攻击结束后，仅考虑该单位周围3格内、有移动力及攻击次数且能原地攻击可见敌人的单位。依次优先：能攻击同一敌人、同一指挥官麾下、同类型（如投石兵、弓箭手）、同军种（如远程、攻城），最后按距离由近及远选择。只选中，不自动攻击。
优化集中开火：参与者高亮
醒目六角框标出可用远程单位，淡金色底座表示参与；悬停敌人筛选可攻击者并显示红色箭头。开启“不移动单位”时，仅能原地射击者保留填色。单独开启高亮仍由原版执行集中开火。
优化集中开火：手动排除单位
默认关闭，需要开启参与者高亮。点击友军取消或恢复淡金色底座，醒目边框始终保留。切换悬停敌人不会恢复手动排除的单位。
更快的增援：切换指挥官
默认预览最近的可增援指挥官；LB／RB、键盘上下、滚轮或面板按钮切换。取消后回到原军事单位。不可增援者不能确认。

选中即加入：快速转移
自动加入状态下，绿色格子预览陆军经相邻且有“先手”的指挥官转移的位置。悬停显示路线和1点移动力；点击后先加入，确认加入成功后再部署。点击有单位的格子仍切换单位。加入后会重新检查部署条件；若无法部署，单位留在指挥官内。
